clusters.headline: Kenyan Leaders Walk Out Of Consultative Forum Hosted By The IEBC
aiSummaryBullets: Prominent opposition figures and other leaders staged a walkout during a consultative forum held by the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission.
The participants expressed concerns regarding their perceived exclusion from discussions surrounding upcoming election preparedness.

clusters.headline: Wetang'ula orders CCTV review as Sabina Chege renews missing phone
aiSummaryBullets: The Standard reports: Wetang'ula orders CCTV review as Sabina Chege renews missing phone
Capital FM reports: Wetang’ula Reopens 2023 Parliament Drama Over Missing Sabina Chege Phone

clusters.headline: President Ruto Commissions Naitiri Market And Launches Bokoli Project
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto commissioned the newly completed Naitiri Economic Stimulus Programme Market in Bungoma County.
The Naitiri market facility includes 200 modern indoor stalls and additional space for 150 outdoor traders.

clusters.headline: President William Ruto And ODM Leaders Discuss Potential Coalition
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto and members of the ODM party have initiated meetings to discuss a possible formal political partnership.
The ODM leadership states that any support for the President's re-election must involve a formal power-sharing agreement.

clusters.headline: NACADA secures major drug trafficking conviction
aiSummaryBullets: KBC reports: NACADA secures major drug trafficking conviction
Capital FM reports: NACADA Secures Historic Conviction in Major Drug Trafficking Case

clusters.headline: Rigathi Gachagua Issues Ultimatum To Mt Kenya Leaders Over Ruto
aiSummaryBullets: Rigathi Gachagua demanded that political leaders in Mt Kenya reconsider their support for President William Ruto by Christmas.
Gachagua emphasized the importance of the Democratic Congress Party nominations for his planned presidential bid.

clusters.headline: President William Ruto Defends His Administration's Economic Record
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto maintains that the nation is experiencing an upward economic trajectory.
The administration claims success in lowering food prices and expanding healthcare services.

clusters.headline: Rigathi Gachagua Pledges To Unite Opposition Leaders By December
aiSummaryBullets: Rigathi Gachagua aims to broker a deal among opposition leaders before the Christmas holiday.
The leader of the DCP stated he is actively working to ensure cooperation among political factions.

clusters.headline: Ruto backs Didmus Barasa for Bungoma governor in 2027
aiSummaryBullets: The Standard reports: Ruto backs Didmus Barasa for Bungoma governor in 2027
KBC reports: Ruto disburses Ksh195M sugarcane farmers’ bonuses in Bungoma

clusters.headline: Teachers Service Commission Announces Over Seven Thousand Vacancies
aiSummaryBullets: The Teachers Service Commission is recruiting for 7,720 permanent teaching positions.
The openings are distributed across primary schools, junior schools, and secondary education institutions.

clusters.headline: Inspector General Douglas Kanja Demands Police Neutrality In Kenya
aiSummaryBullets: Inspector General of Police Douglas Kanja has formally advised officers to maintain impartiality during the electoral cycle.
The directive emphasizes the need for professionalism among uniformed services as Kenya approaches the 2027 General Election.

clusters.headline: Court of Arbitration for Sport Reinstates Senegal As AFCON Winners
aiSummaryBullets: The Court of Arbitration for Sport upheld an appeal filed by the Senegalese Football Federation.
The ruling overturns previous outcomes regarding the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final match.

clusters.headline: Government Enhances Security On The Isiolo-Garissa Border Region
aiSummaryBullets: Government officials are intensifying security operations along the border between Isiolo and Garissa counties.
Cabinet Secretary Kipchumba Murkomen has mandated a crackdown on the possession of illegal firearms in the area.

clusters.headline: Hustler Fund gets Ksh5B boost as Ruto raises borrowing limits
aiSummaryBullets: KBC reports: Hustler Fund gets Ksh5B boost as Ruto raises borrowing limits
Capital FM reports: Government adds Sh5bn to Hustler Fund, raises borrowing limits

clusters.headline: UDA Threatens To Boycott IEBC Consultations Over Harassment Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The UDA has threatened to boycott future IEBC consultative meetings following reports of delegate harassment.
IEBC Commissioner Alutalala Mukhwana has formally apologized for meeting disruptions and committed to enhancing security.

clusters.headline: EACC steps up scrutiny of candidates’ integrity ahead of 2027 elections
aiSummaryBullets: KBC reports: EACC steps up scrutiny of candidates’ integrity ahead of 2027 elections
Capital FM reports: EACC flags past vetting failures, calls for tougher candidate scrutiny ahead of 2027 polls

clusters.headline: High Court Rejects Bid To Declare Life Imprisonment Unconstitutional
aiSummaryBullets: The High Court of Kenya dismissed a petition that challenged the constitutionality of life imprisonment sentences.
Lady Justice Roselyne Aburili ruled that judicial bodies do not have the legal authority to convert life terms into fixed prison sentences.

clusters.headline: Nvidia Reinstates CEO Jensen Huang Following Donald Trump Pressure
aiSummaryBullets: Jensen Huang has been reinstated as the CEO of Nvidia following his departure less than two weeks ago.
The reappointment occurred shortly after Nvidia initially declined a previous offer from Huang to resume his leadership role.

clusters.headline: Kenyan Cult Leader Receives 200 Year Sentence For Shakahola Deaths
aiSummaryBullets: Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to 200 years in prison for his role in the deaths of 191 individuals.
The judicial decision follows a conviction on 191 counts of murder issued by the court on October 19, 2026.

clusters.headline: Kenya Discharges Final Ebola Patient As Disease-Free Status Nears
aiSummaryBullets: Kenya has successfully discharged the last of its nine confirmed Ebola patients from hospital care.
Health authorities have officially initiated a 42-day observation period to monitor for any potential resurgence of the virus.
